program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h2_1 = rightmost(true, !is_b@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(true, !h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j)
h4_1 = rightmost(!h2_1@i & h3_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, !h2_1@i & h3_1@i & !is_bos@j & is_b@j)
accept = !is_bos & h2_1 & !h3_1 & !h4_1

output accept
